title: Panda reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <!-- Panda belly / lap -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#ececf5'/>
  <!-- Panda head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='20' fill='#ececf5'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='24' r='8' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='24' r='8' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='24' r='4' fill='#5a5f9b'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='24' r='4' fill='#5a5f9b'/>
  <!-- Eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='38' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='38' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#272b50'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#272b50'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 53 54 50' stroke='#3a3f6b' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='32' y='60' width='36' height='24' rx='2' fill='#e05a5a'/>
  <rect x='33' y='61' width='17' height='22' rx='1' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <rect x='50' y='61' width='17' height='22' rx='1' fill='#fff3e0'/>
  <!-- Book spine highlight -->
  <rect x='49' y='61' width='2' height='22' fill='#d04a4a'/>
  <!-- Lines of text on book -->
  <line x1='36' y1='66' x2='47' y2='66' stroke='#c9b8a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='70' x2='47' y2='70' stroke='#c9b8a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='74' x2='47' y2='74' stroke='#c9b8a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='66' x2='64' y2='66' stroke='#c9b8a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='70' x2='64' y2='70' stroke='#c9b8a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='74' x2='64' y2='74' stroke='#c9b8a8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='72' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='72' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='94' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='94' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='94' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#5a5f9b'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='94' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#5a5f9b'/>
</svg>
